name: Casa Monarch
description: Fictional two-storey family home that doubles as the Monarch tutorial: the Gallery on the ground floor shows one exhibit per way of getting an object into the model.
origin_note: Local frame: x east, y north, z up. Origin = south-west outer corner of the ground-floor envelope at finished floor level. Footprint 11.0 x 8.5 m, garden and terrace to the south, entrance from the north.
